resources.string: The results below come from sample request analysis. They do not represent every content type or vendor implementation, and no app will be opened.
No host was confirmed. A default handler may already exist, or the system may use another resolver implementation.
The host or process is not confirmed compatible. It will not be requested automatically. Check it manually in LSPosed; do not expand the scope to all system apps.
android provides a fallback for the framework resolver UI; system handles global query filtering in the system service. They cannot replace each other.

Additional scope not confirmed by this host detection: %1$s It may come from an older version or manual configuration and has been retained. Check it in LSPosed and remove it only if no longer needed.
No runtime targets were found; this does not necessarily mean the scope is incorrect.
Module loading does not mean filtering succeeded. Verify rules by opening the actual share or file chooser; text processing does not guarantee coverage of in-app menus.
Advanced configuration: manage this manually in LSPosed → this module → Scope. Selecting every application is not recommended.
